title: CBR signal contract (engine -> every execution backend)
description: PLANNING DRAFT (CBR-ARCH-014 §3, 2026-09-14). Finalized in Phase 11, frozen before Phase 13. Written once by the CBR reference engine; immutable during execution. Execution layers (custom simulator 14A, Backtesting.py adapter 14B) may not create, delete or edit signals. Owner ruling D14-1: the contract carries canonical stop INPUTS; the executable stop is resolved by the authoritative simulator (OQ-28 open). Owner ruling D16: every price in a signal (extremes, ranges, trigger, target, stop anchor) is STRUCTURE price (tick-derived mid, TICK_MID); execution prices (bid/ask) never appear in a signal. Owner ruling D17-2 (OQ-35): stop anchor = most adverse STRUCTURE extreme of the active extension observed up to entry activation / fill; the anchor at activation, its time, source and path are carried separately from the decision-time extreme, sweep extreme, fill-time extreme and final execution stop.

timestamp.description: Decision time, UTC: close time of the last bar used; all inputs closed at or before it

entry_trigger_time.description: Open time of the first bar on which the entry order is active (> timestamp). Not the fill time

entry_expiry_time.description: Unfilled order cancelled at this time (timing.end)

stop_price.description: OPTIONAL reference level only: extension_extreme +/- canonical buffer, spread-free. NOT an executable stop (D14-1). May be null.

stop_rule.description: Canonical stop inputs sufficient to reproduce the stop deterministically (D14-1, OQ-28 open).

extension_extreme.description: oe_extreme at decision time (the extreme the stop sits beyond)

direction.description: stop is below the extreme for LONG, above for SHORT

source.description: evidence ids / open questions, e.g. OQ-11

spread_policy.description: current machine spec: ADD_SPREAD_AT_FILL (M1H-SL-01); OQ-28 open

execution_inputs.description: spread/execution inputs when available at decision time; resolution happens in the simulator

extension_extreme_at_decision.description: extension extreme from closed 1m bars at decision time

sweep_extreme.description: type 3 sweep bar extreme at decision

structure_stop_anchor.description: D17-2: most adverse STRUCTURE extreme of the extension through entry activation

stop_anchor_path.description: each later new extreme [close_time, value] until the order ends; the execution layer takes the latest value at or before its fill (never reads STRUCTURE bars)

structure_extreme_at_fill.description: resolved by the execution layer; null in engine output

target_price.description: oe_extreme - 0.5 x (oe_extreme - candle.open), mirrored for LONG

context_state.description: condition class, OE state, timing-window state

session_state.description: session label; active no-trade windows NT_SYDNEY / NT_ROLLOVER / NT_INCOMPLETE

reason_code.description: ARMED, or a no-trade code (BLOCKED_*, INVALIDATED_*, NT_*, MISSING_DATA)

spec_hash.description: Hash of machine spec + strategy.yaml + engine code

price_role.description: D16: all signal prices are STRUCTURE prices; fills/touches are resolved on EXECUTION bars by the simulator

eligibility.description: D17: explicit baseline eligibility and blockers (e.g. HTF_NOT_EVALUATED, COND03_INTERPRETATION_UNAPPROVED)
